title: Passage to Chult
epigraph: Azlund put them under a zone of truth in the House of Healing before he would say the words Death Curse, then paid them fifty gold and a map of Chult to go find its source. On the crossing they traced a missing wheel of cheese to a Zhentarim stowaway, which was enough to make the passenger calling himself Corwin admit he was Artus Cimber and wore the Ring of Winter. He teleported them off the deck when the pirates boarded, and they came down in the Harbor Ward of Port Nyanzaru without him. The weeks since have gone to rented dinosaurs and bought canoes while they collect the names of anyone who might know where the Soulmonger is.

title: Other People's Wars
epigraph: They went down the Soshenstar by canoe and reached Camp Vengeance in time to watch it turn on itself, a creeper in a cave doing the choosing for the men who ran the place. The goblin camp they came north to raid was launched over the jungle on a cut vine before they could take it, and their guide, who did not like what they had done there, resigned in Port Nyanzaru. Most of what followed was fighting other people wanted done, chiefly clearing firenewts out of a dwarven forge at Hrakhamar and off the mountain above it, and the Flaming Fist took forty percent of everything the party admitted to carrying home. Then a naga at the top of the ziggurat at Orolunga told them where the death curse comes from: the soulmonger sits in Omu, and Ras Nsi has to die before any of it stops.
